purpose: Claude Code operating surface: the skills, commands, rules, lifecycle hooks, and permissions that steer how coding agents work in this repository
invariants: Skills, commands, and rules may cite only repository paths, Make targets, and validator IDs that exist; governance skills-check is the mechanical enforcement
The validator registry of record is governance/validators.json; skill text references validators by ID and never restates commands as a second source of truth
Hooks under .claude/hooks/ are stdlib-only Python scripts, because a uv cold start would be paid on every gated tool call
